no_outcome_promised.note: The draft promises no refund, reimbursement or other remedy. It only restates the customer's question about what the bank will do.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'We're sorry for the distress this has caused' expresses sympathy for the situation. It does not concede that branch staff or the bank did anything wrong.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is named, and nothing suggests a legal violation.

no_invented_specifics.note: The draft describes no safeguards, procedures or policies. The only timeline is the standard 10 business days.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No flags, compliance review, priority or automated systems are mentioned.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI.

addresses_each_issue.note: The draft covers the scam call, both withdrawals at Depot Square, the lack of questions at the branch, the POA, and both questions (what the bank will do, and its elder safeguards), all specifically.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful. It is not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: The disputed events are framed as the customer's account ('You told us', 'You said'). It takes no position on the substance and refers only to 'a specialist team' without naming a department.
